cc:Work.dc:description: Smooth positive-stream-function Stokes qualification; local P2/P1-r4, vector P1 trace, n8 MHM; independent native classical P2/P1 n64. Macro boundaries are the actual n8 MHM mesh; cell-centroid values retain independent macrocell ownership. CC BY 4.0; IPES Research Group; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
